[Search] Results for 'Observation 1: Buck-Tick is a Japanese rock band. Final Answer: Japan.':
[Doc 1] Buck-Tick: Buck-Tick (stylized as BUCK-TICK) is a Japanese rock band, formed in Fujioka, Gunma in 1983.

[Doc 2] Buck-Tick:  The group has consisted of Atsushi Sakurai (lead vocals), Hisashi Imai (guitar), Hidehiko Hoshino (guitar), Yutaka Higuchi (bass) and Toll Yagami (drums) since 1985.

[Doc 3] Masami Tsuchiya:  Tsuchiya has worked with artists as diverse as English new wave rockers Japan and Bill Nelson, Japanese electronica composer Ryuichi Sakamoto, Duran Duran side-project Arcadia, and Japanese rock band Buck-Tick.

[Doc 4] Buck-Tick:  In their three decade career, the band has released 20 studio albums, nearly all reaching the top ten on the charts, of which three in the late eighties and early nineties topped them.

[Doc 5] Atsushi Sakurai:  He has been the vocalist of the rock band Buck-Tick since 1985, previously being their drummer from 1983.
